'''Zrinka Tamburašev''' was a Croatian scientist known for her work in the development of antibiotics such as [[oxytetracycline]] and [[azithromycin]].

== Early life ==
Tamburašev was born in [[Sisak]], [[Kingdom of Yugoslavia]], in 1921. She graduated in 1948 from the Chemical-Technological Department of the Technical Faculty in Zagreb and earned her doctorate in 1965.<ref name=":4">{{Cite journal |last=Kovačević |first=Kruno |date=2003-01-27 |title=In memoriam - Dr. sc. Zrinka Tamburašev |url=https://hrcak.srce.hr/20534 |journal=Medicus |language=hr |volume=12 |issue=1_ Kardiologija |pages=151 |issn=1330-013X}}</ref>
== Career ==
[[File:From left to right - Gabrijela Kobrehel, Slobodan Dokic, Gorjana Radobolja-Lazarevski and Zrinka Tamburasev.png|thumb|From left to right - Gabrijela Kobrehel, Slobodan Dokic, Gorjana Radobolja-Lazarevski and Zrinka Tamburasev]]She joined the research institute of the pharmaceutical company [[Pliva|PLIVA]] in 1957,<ref name=":4" /> where she made several discoveries and patents in departments of [[microbiology]], [[biochemistry]], and [[biotechnology]]. While at PLIVA she led the group for semisynthetic macrolides from 1972 to 1974, and in 1974 she was named the head of the natural products department.<ref name=":3">{{Cite journal |last=Kovcevic |first=Kruno |date=2003 |title=In memoriam – Dr. Zrinka Tamburašev |url=http://silverstripe.fkit.hr/kui/issue-archive/issue/119 |journal=Journal of Chemists and Chemical Engineers of Croatia |volume=52 |issue=6 |pages=287}}</ref>

In the mid-1960s, she worked with Slobodan Đokić on erythromycin A derivatives and on sulfonamide derivatives of erythromycylamine, with the idea of combining the properties of [[erythromycin]] and [[sulfonamide]]s. She began work on the synthesis of individual phases for the preparation of azithromycin, and the results of this research challenged the previous understanding of the [[Macrocycle|macrocyclic]] ring of erythromycin as the bearer of the antibacterial activity of macrolides. In 1974 her collaboration with  [[Slobodan Đokić]], [[Gabrijela Kobrehel]], and [[Gorjana Lazarevski]] led to the development of azithromycin, an erythromycin derivative later established in the American market as [[Azithromycin|Zithromax]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Mikulčić |first=V. Godinić |date=2020-03-11 |title=Tamburašev, Zrinka {{!}} Hrvatska tehnička enciklopedija |url=https://tehnika.lzmk.hr/tamburasev-zrinka/ |access-date=2023-12-04 |language=hr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Domínguez |first=Oriol Güell |date=9 Dec 2023 |title=Las resistencias bacterianas amenazan a la azitromicina, uno de los fármacos más vendidos del mundo |work=EL PAÍS (Mexico Edition); Miami |id={{ProQuest|<!-- Insert ProQuest data here -->}} ]}}</ref>

She devised a method for isolating the antibiotic oxytetracycline in its industrial production and dealt with the chemical transformations of tetracycline order antibiotics and erythromycin. She is a co-author of patents that protected the preparation of oximes of erythromycin A and erythromycylamine, important intermediates in the synthesis of second-generation macrolide antibiotics (azithromycin, clarithromycin, roxithromycin, and dirithromycin).<ref name=":0" />

Tamburašev died on April 24, 2003,<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |date=April 25, 2003 |title=Preminula Zrinka Tamburašev, jedna od izumitelja Sumameda |url=https://www.index.hr/clanak.aspx?id=133819 |access-date=2023-12-04 |website=www.index.hr |language=hr}}</ref> in [[Zagreb]], [[Croatia]], at the age of 82.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Tamburašev, Zrinka |url=https://www.enciklopedija.hr/clanak/tamburasev-zrinka |access-date=2023-12-04 |website=www.enciklopedija.hr}}</ref>

== Honors and awards ==
Following the discovery of [[azithromycin]], she became the recipient of the City of Zagreb Award<ref name=":1" /> for 1959, the PLIVA Award for 1996,<ref name=":3" /> and the Croatian Chamber of Economy's Golden Marten Award for Lifetime Achievement for 1998.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |last=Anđelković |first=Katarina |date=2023-03-07 |title=Antibiotics, Vegeta, Lasers: Meet the Legendary Croatian Female Scientists |url=https://total-croatia-news.com/lifestyle/croatian-female-scientists/ |access-date=2023-12-04 |website=Total Croatia |language=en-US}}</ref> In 1998 she also received the Nagrade HAZU-a.<ref name=":0" />
